The '''Endor Forest Ranger''' was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorlift vehicle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Offscreen" /> With its unique [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]-controlled [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] capable of supporting a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the vehicle was designed for maneuvering through the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Endor/Legends|Sanctuary Moon of Endor]],<ref name="Kenner" /> where in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] the Alliance fought the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] against the Empire.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Endor Forest Ranger had two gyroscopic wings and a large [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] on each side.<ref name="Offscreen" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[1984]], [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] created the Endor Forest Ranger for the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' toy line]]. The packaging and assembly instructions showed the craft being [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel commando]]&ndash;operated.<ref name="Kenner" /> In [[1985]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/10342/new_mutants_special_edition_1985_1|text=New Mutants Special Edition (1985) #1}}</ref> [[Marvel Comics]]' [[W:c:Marvel:New Mutants Special Edition Vol 1 1|''New Mutants Special Edition'' #1]] replicated the Endor Forest Ranger's design<ref name="Offscreen" /> when the character [[Wikipedia:Warlock (New Mutants)|Warlock]] briefly transforms himself into a vehicle.<ref name="comic">[[W:c:Marvel:New Mutants Special Edition Vol 1 1|''New Mutants Special Edition'' #1]]</ref>
